about_short_description.short_description: Vinci VR has created an industry 360 degree immersive virtual reality training experience for technician trainees.

product.name: Vinci StudioS
product.description: Vinci VR offers custom-developed VR experiences and training solutions that simulate specific worksite environments for various industries, aiming to reduce training costs and risks.

product.name: Immersive Classroom Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates AI-powered instructors and realistic simulations for hands-on training in VR, designed to support independent and remote learning.

product.name: Content Library
product.description: A collection of VR modules focused on green energy careers, industry education, and workforce training, available for integration into educational and training programs.

product.name: Career Exploration
product.description: VR modules designed to introduce and guide users through potential careers in the green energy sector, providing realistic job previews and industry insights.

product.name: Industry Education
product.description: Educational VR experiences that teach users about wind projects, including turbine construction and the impact of green energy, aimed at increasing industry understanding.

product.name: Workforce Training
product.description: VR training modules for technical skills development, compatible with certified training programs like GWO, designed to enhance skill acquisition and job readiness.
